description: Paired Python MCP corpus: FastMCP @mcp.tool() functions and low-level @server.call_tool() handlers receive model-chosen arguments. A passing run requires the expected rule on every vulnerable file and no same-rule finding on its fixed pair.

cases.class: FastMCP tool argument to open(); a confining resolver is the fix
FastMCP tool argument in a shell=True command; an argument list is the fix
FastMCP tool argument as the request URL; a fixed host with only the path controlled is the fix
low-level @server.call_tool() arguments to open(); basename under a fixed root is the fix
FastMCP tool argument passed to a helper module that shells out
tool argument to Path(...).read_text(); keeping only .name under a fixed root is the fix
tool argument as the URL of an httpx.AsyncClient request; a fixed host is the fix
tool argument passed to a same-file helper that opens the path
tool argument passed to a helper module that fetches it with an httpx client
FastMCP tool argument to sympy parse_expr, which evaluates its input as Python (GHSA-mw6r-2hvm-4rp2 shape); a strict arithmetic allowlist is the fix
FastMCP tool argument through a path helper that accepts absolute paths into openpyxl load_workbook (GHSA-j98m-w3xp-9f56 shape); realpath + commonpath containment is the fix
